This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The CSV export deliberately prefixes the file content with a UTF-8 byte order mark (BOM) by default. This is explained in src/export/csv.ts to help spreadsheet apps detect UTF-8 encoding when opening CSV files directly. The BOM usage is currently on by default but can be disabled via an option. This is expected behavior, not a bug or change request.
